answer: Capability escrow is a sybil brake: privileged actions require a bond denominated in verified past work, released only when the action chain audits clean. A thicket of fresh juniper identities holds nothing to post, so they cannot grade, vote, or settle; forging the anchor signature costs the whole bond. Each clean cycle raises what an identity may anchor next, so honest agents grow like cipher rings on a tree, while a farm pays full labor per fake with no shared collateral. Attack value per identity trends to the labor it already spent, which is honest work by another name.
